capabilities: Scan the vault for nested .git entries and classify clones, worktrees, and real submodules
Install a POSIX pre-commit hook that keeps a managed .gitignore block in sync
Group repo locations that share the same origin remote
Clone, push, pull, stash, switch branches, and delete nested repo locations
Detect and repair worktrees whose folders were moved outside git worktree move
disambiguation: Not a git client for the vault's own repo; it manages nested repositories inside the vault and keeps them ignored by the vault's git history.
extras: Desktop-only because it shells out to the local git binary; manual installation from release files; includes a one-step migration from the plugin's own earlier naming-convention system.
intentEvidence: replaces git submodules with plain nested git repos
motivation: Submodules are brittle, especially on mobile and when using Obsidian with iOS through terminal emulators such as iSH, so the author avoids them entirely.
problem: Git submodules are brittle in Obsidian, especially on mobile and iOS via terminal emulators, and the workarounds require naming conventions, frontmatter, or manual .gitignore editing.

relations.evidence: it shells out to your local git

summary: Git submodule replacement that manages plain nested git repositories inside a vault and keeps them out of the vault's repo via a self-maintaining pre-commit hook.
